photos.title: File:01-21-2017 - Women's March on NYC looking down 42nd (10794).jpg
photos.author: Rhododendrites
photos.description: Looking down 42nd St. from its intersection with 5th Ave. at the Women's March on New York City on January 21, 2017. The march was to support equality and civil rights and to oppose the presidency of Donald Trump, whose inauguration was the day before. Hundreds of thousands of people marched from Dag Hammarskjold Plaza down 2nd Ave., west on 42nd St., then north on 5th Ave. to Trump Tower.
